Pricing.title: Pricing that follows actual usage.
Pricing.description: Purchase credits to pseudonymize your data. We charge strictly based on the volume of data you process. No monthly subscriptions, no hidden fees.
Pricing.faq1A: An input token corresponds to a chunk of text or data parsed by our pseudonymization engine. 1 million tokens is roughly equivalent to 750,000 words.
Pricing.faq2A: No, your purchased credits remain in your account indefinitely until they are consumed by your API requests.
Pricing.faq3Q: How do I add more credits?
Pricing.faq3A: You can top up your balance at any time from your dashboard using a credit card.

About.title: Sensitive data should not travel farther than it needs to.
About.description: Many workflows need the information around an identifier without needing the identifier itself. pseudonymize.io exists to make that separation practical.

Developers.title: Put pseudonymization in the path of sensitive data.
Developers.description: Use the API or supported integration surface to replace identifiers before content reaches downstream systems that do not require the originals.
Developers.requestHeading: One real request. One real result.

Product.title: One pseudonymization layer for text, structured data and files.
Product.description: Send supported content through one processing layer, replace detected identifiers with pseudonyms, and continue working with the surrounding context intact.
Product.textCopy: Replace identifiers inside prose without flattening the text around them.
Product.dataCopy: Pseudonymize identifier fields while keeping rows and schemas usable.

Product.modelHeading: The context stays. The identifiers change.
